page.layout: One page of text, single column; a large decorated initial opens the first paragraph; no margin notes. Page number top right; signature at foot centre.

main_text.l: Εε Εψιλὸν Epsilon Ee tenue, seu breve.
Hη Ητα Eta Ee crassum, seu longum.
Oo Ομικρὸν Omicron Oo paruum, seu breve.
Ωω Ωμέγα Omega Oo magnum, seu longum.
Υυ Υψιλὸν Ypsilon Y tenue, u liquidum.

l.i: non usum, sed abusum per varias scholas.

page.notes: The Greek words are reproduced from the scan; the decorated initial I is joined to "ITERÆ". The letters Ε ε and Η η are set with an unusual shape in the scan; some Greek accents are faint and may be imprecise.
